cues: If it will rain: no will in the if clause, if it rains.
If I would have known: had known.
Unless you don't hurry: unless already contains not.
In case it will be cold: in case it is cold.
And if he would be here: if he were here.
text: And the six errors. If it will rain: no will in the if clause, if it rains. If I would have known: had known. If I was you: were. Unless you don't hurry: unless already contains not. In case it will be cold: in case it is cold. And if he would be here: if he were here.
